title: A different host
question: Does a Lacephage infect a Sprinter?
intervention: Watch the mesh patch. Tap an infected Velvet, then a Sprinter sitting in a cell with Lacephage units, and compare what the inspector says.
predictedTradeoff: Lacephage can only use Velvets: Velvets near whole units can be infected, while Sprinters in the same cells are not.
confounds: Sprinters and Velvets share the cells with whole Lacephage units, so a Sprinter's zero is measured against real encounters (the whole-unit cells count). Infections are counted when they happen; an infected Velvet may burst later. This is one run.

all.label: A Velvet was infected by Lacephage
No Sprinter was infected by Lacephage
Sprinters sat in cells with whole Lacephage units
